Anant Nag Honored with Dadasaheb Phalke Award

Veteran actor Anant Nag has been honored with the Dadasaheb Phalke Award. The award recognizes his significant contributions to cinema over several decades. Coverage highlights his career spanning multiple languages and his versatility as an actor. Rare photographs from his career have also been featured, showcasing his journey through the years.
